verses.text: In the fourth year that Darius was king, the LORD gave a message to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Kislev.
The people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem Melech, along with their men, to ask for the LORD's favor.
They were to ask the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and the prophets, "Should we continue to mourn and fast in the fifth month, as we have done for so many years?"
Then the LORD of Armies gave me this message:
"Ask all the people of the land and the priests, 'For seventy years you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months. Was it really for me that you fasted?
And when you eat and drink, aren't you eating and drinking just for yourselves?

Aren't these the same words the LORD announced through the earlier prophets, when Jerusalem and the towns around it were full of people and doing well, and people lived in the Negev and the western foothills?'"
And the LORD gave this message to Zechariah:
"This is what the LORD of Armies says: 'Judge fairly. Show faithful love and mercy to one another.
Do not oppress widows, orphans, foreigners, or the poor. Do not plot evil against one another in your hearts.'
"But they refused to pay attention. They stubbornly turned their backs and covered their ears so they would not hear.

They made their hearts as hard as stone and would not listen to the law or the messages that the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit through the earlier prophets. So the LORD of Armies was very angry.
"'When I called, they did not listen. So when they called, I would not listen,' says the LORD of Armies.

'I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations, where they were strangers. The land they left behind was so ruined that no one traveled through it. That is how they turned the pleasant land into a wasteland.'"
